new.title: A customer still waiting for director vetting can be quoted by typing its name instead of picking it
new.body: The seeded Customer qualification flow (director) ticks customer_reference: 'A customer must be vetted before it can be referenced on documents.' The only enforcement is a filter in company.search, which hides unvetted companies from the Client picker. The picker still accepts free text and clears the company link when the user types, and quotation.create does not check the gate on the server. At step 5, sales can therefore type the unvetted company's name and save, send and convert the quote. The resulting order and bills (steps 11-24) carry only a free-text name with no company record. That bypasses the director review and loses the link that step 9 uses to pre-fill To from the primary contact. Refuter c-003 CONFIRMED (scoped audit wf_bd4d638d-39b).

evidence.quote: * apart. UX only: `quotation.create` does not enforce this gate.
